notes.title: Major update available today! Enjoy the world of OU more deeply!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "OU".

"OU" released a free major update today, December 20, with the additional story "Zarry's Story," which takes place in U-chronia after the ending of the game, and an "picture book" that allows users to more deeply enjoy the terms and backgrounds that appeared in the game. In addition, the game is now available in six new languages, making it even more powerful and enjoyable for even more "OU" fans!

[b][u]Update addition: additional story "Zarry's Story"[/u][/b].
A new story, "Zarry's Story," will be available. 
The story will be told in U-chronia after the main story is cleared, with Zarry as the main character. 
 
*"Zarry's Story" will be added to "BONUS CONTENT" in the title menu after the conditions are met.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671387/916c2acd1182ebe39d9970d5bd45343110157fb2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671387/87d8d3471515ddc914b9ac5aafd89bc32211429b.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Update addition: new mode "U-CHRONIA-PEDIA"[/u][/b].
The "U-CHRONIA-PEDIA" will be added to provide a more in-depth look at the world of OU. 
In the "Places and Concepts" and "Characters," you can enjoy detailed information on terms and characters that appeared in the game. 
In the "Gallery" section, the background of each stage can be enlarged and moved, allowing you to take a closer look at the intricate backgrounds. 
*The "U-CHRONIA-PEDIA" will be added to the "BONUS CONTENT" in the title menu after the conditions are met. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671387/418f3a52cad86bbc525183f38bd38d7a49d9cd6c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40671387/20b01b6f16c67c7be9934904227cdf60b67e239b.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Six new languages have been added, for a total of eight languages![/u][/b]
"OU" has been available in Japanese and English until now, but now 6 new languages have been added: Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese, making a total of 8 languages available. 
With the addition of these languages, more people will be able to enjoy "OU".
